headline: Analyst upgrade wave hits TSLA: Morningstar raises FV to $450 from $425; Gary Black (Future Fund) predicts sell-side estimate tsunami following Q2 delivery blowout; Morgan Stanley maintains Equal Weight $415 — Morningstar says 'majority' of Tesla value now in AI/robotics (robotaxi 35%, FSD subs 20%, Optimus 30%); Gary Black: 'I expect TSLA to rebound this week as sell-side climbs over one another to raise 2Q/FY26 ests'; caution: TSLA trades at 200x+ 2026 P/E with a 6x PEG ratio — 'continues to suggest TSLA is fully priced'; Q2 beat was partly gasoline-price driven (avg US gas spike from $2.98 to $3.86 over July 4 weekend) per Black; Morgan Stanley noted Q2 deliveries beat consensus by 18% and were the highest automotive growth rate since Q3 2023 (ForeignPolicyJournal / Morgan Stanley, Jul 7, 2026)

Lars Moravy podcast interview reveals: Cybercab lines at Giga Texas running 90%+ automated, ~150 units built — most now serving as training vehicles for unsupervised FSD; a dedicated burn-in track is now live on the Giga Texas campus perimeter for validation; Moravy teased a 'Scaling Big' announcement at Giga Texas today (Jul 7) expected to cover production rate milestone or next-city commercial launch; separately, Moravy confirmed next-gen Roadster will also be built at Giga Texas and owners will 'start to see things unfold in the next months'; Cybercab production architecture 90%+ automated underscores Tesla's unboxed manufacturing execution ahead of commercial service (podcastalpha / notateslaapp / basenor, Jul 2–7, 2026)

Optimus production ramp accelerating at Fremont: 100–150 units/week targeted in July, ~300/week in August, 1,000/week by September — a potential 10x scale in 60 days that would be the steepest humanoid robot production ramp in history; Moravy confirmed Fremont line uses modular architecture that adapts as hardware evolves without teardown, enabling faster iteration; ex-Tesla Optimus AI scientist unveiled European humanoid startup Uma Robotics (Electrek, Jul 7) citing talent density as maturation signal; Q2 earnings call Jul 22 is expected to provide the first official production rate confirmation; if trajectories hold, Optimus transitions from R&D program to genuine volume production in Q3 2026 (BigGo Finance / Electrek, Jul 7, 2026)

Tesla Cybercab demoed at National Federation of the Blind 2026 Convention — Braille labels on door releases and emergency stop button confirmed; space for service animals; visually impaired attendees tested the steering-wheel-free cabin firsthand at the NFB annual conference in Austin; Tesla Robotaxi account posted demo footage; accessibility-first design positions Cybercab as a transformative mobility tool for the 7M+ legally blind Americans who cannot independently operate conventional vehicles; confirms Tesla is actively pursuing ADA-compliant autonomous ride service ahead of commercial launch (Teslarati / KLIF / Tesla Robotaxi on X, Jul 6–7, 2026)
source: Teslarati / KLIF / Tesla Robotaxi on X

headline: Pre-earnings analyst debate: 'Should you buy TSLA before July 22?' — Motley Fool characterizes TSLA as an 'expensive momentum stock' whose valuation rests more on hype than near-term financials; Q2 480K delivery blowout 'didn't rescue the stock'; bears argue the selloff confirms market is paying for autonomy, not EVs; bulls expect gross margin recovery on Jul 22 as delivery leverage kicks in; automotive gross margin print is the single swing factor for the stock into Q3 — Q1 was 21.1%, and the question is whether Q2 volume at lower incentives improves or degrades that figure (Motley Fool / Tikr.com, Jul 7, 2026)

TSLA surges +6.69% on July 6 — biggest Magnificent 7 gainer as market anticipates Lars Moravy's July 7 Giga Texas 'cool news' announcement on Cybercab production scaling; Dow crosses 53,000 for first time in history; AI-tied stocks lead broad rally (AMD +6.5%, QCOM +6%); Nasdaq-100 +1.43%, S&P 500 +0.87%; TSLA closed $419.77 (+$26.32) vs prior close of $393.45; stock now up ~6.7% YTD and +33% over past year (Investopedia / Yahoo Finance, Jul 6, 2026)

Electrek: Cybercab — 100+ units in Giga Texas outbound lot but unsupervised fleet shrinking to ~14 vehicles — Tesla is mass-producing a steering-wheel-less Cybercab it cannot yet sell or drive itself at scale; production-before-autonomy tension crystallized; Austin unsupervised fleet slid from peak ~25 active vehicles to ~14 as safety validation lags manufacturing; FSD crash rate ~4x human urban baseline per NHTSA; Musk confirmed robotaxi 'not material until 2027'; NHTSA self-cert path eliminates 2,500-unit cap so production scaling is uncapped; commercial passenger service gated by FSD v15 (end-2026/early 2027); manufacturing S-curve executing ahead of software timeline (Electrek, Jul 6, 2026)

Tesla Miami Robotaxi goes LIVE for rider service — first driverless rides outside Texas completed July 5-6; Tesla officially announced 'service is now available in Miami' on X July 5; geofenced area covers West Miami, Doral, and Coral Gables including Miami International Airport (MIA); Model Y fleet operational with no driver or safety monitor; first public rider videos and walkaround footage circulating on social media; TechTimes notes Florida's tropical rain is the hardest test yet for camera-only FSD — operating in precipitation, high humidity, and complex multi-lane airport approach roads; confirms Miami is Tesla's first operational driverless city outside Texas (gurufocus / TipRanks / TechTimes, Jul 5–6, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 BLOWOUT: 480,126 deliveries (+25% YoY, +34% QoQ) — smashes 406K consensus by 74K and beats even the most bullish Wall St estimates (Goldman/JPMorgan 420K, Barclays 418K); Tesla's best-ever Q2 and first YoY delivery growth since 2023; drew down inventory (delivered 28K more than produced — reversal of Q1's 50K inventory build); Model 3/Y: 467,762; Other: 12,364; energy: 13.5 GWh +40% YoY; BYD BEV gap narrows from 220K to 77K (BYD 557K BEV, -8% YoY; Tesla +25%); TSLA stock dropped — market awaits Jul 22 earnings to see if volume recovery translated to margin (Electrek / CNBC / Yahoo Finance, Jul 2, 2026)
